schema: SELECT table_name FROM user_tables WHERE table_name = 'N_RECOMMENDATION_FEEDBACK'
lockActor: SELECT user_id FROM n_users WHERE user_id = :actor_id AND is_active = 1 FOR UPDATE

targets.post: SELECT p.post_id AS resource_id FROM n_posts p WHERE p.post_id = :resource_id AND p.is_deleted = 0 AND fn_can_view_post(:actor_id, p.post_id) = 1
targets.user:
SELECT u.user_id AS resource_id FROM n_users u LEFT JOIN n_user_settings s ON s.user_id = u.user_id
WHERE u.user_id = :resource_id AND u.is_active = 1
AND (u.user_id = :actor_id OR (COALESCE(s.profile_visibility, 'public') = 'public' AND NOT EXISTS (
  SELECT 1 FROM n_user_blocks b WHERE (b.user_id = :actor_id AND b.target_user_id = u.user_id)
  OR (b.user_id = u.user_id AND b.target_user_id = :actor_id)
)))
targets.group:
SELECT g.group_id AS resource_id FROM n_groups g
WHERE g.group_id = :resource_id AND g.is_active = 1 AND g.is_deleted = 0
AND (g.privacy = 'public' OR EXISTS (
  SELECT 1 FROM n_group_members m WHERE m.group_id = g.group_id AND m.user_id = :actor_id AND m.status = 'active'
))
targets.tag: SELECT tag_id AS resource_id FROM n_tags WHERE tag_id = :resource_id

save:
MERGE INTO n_recommendation_feedback f USING (
  SELECT :actor_id AS user_id, :resource_type AS resource_type, :resource_id AS resource_id,
    :action AS action, CAST(:reason AS VARCHAR2(500)) AS reason FROM dual
) s ON (f.user_id = s.user_id AND f.resource_type = s.resource_type AND f.resource_id = s.resource_id)
WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET
  f.updated_at = CASE WHEN f.action <> s.action OR NVL(f.reason, CHR(0)) <> NVL(s.reason, CHR(0))
    THEN CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ELSE f.updated_at END,
  f.action = s.action, f.reason = s.reason
WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT (user_id, resource_type, resource_id, action, reason)
VALUES (s.user_id, s.resource_type, s.resource_id, s.action, s.reason)
feedFilter:
AND NOT EXISTS (
  SELECT 1 FROM n_recommendation_feedback rf
  WHERE rf.user_id = :viewer_id AND rf.resource_type = 'post' AND rf.resource_id = v.post_id AND rf.action = 'not_interested'
)
feedOrder:
CASE WHEN EXISTS (
  SELECT 1 FROM n_recommendation_feedback rf JOIN n_posts fp ON fp.post_id = rf.resource_id
  WHERE rf.user_id = :viewer_id AND rf.resource_type = 'post' AND rf.action = 'show_less' AND fp.author_id = v.author_id
) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
